text:
sara_partnerships: Quick sync — we need final signoff for the cloud catalog publish playbook. Main gaps: legal redlines, SKU packaging, trial entitlement limits, and credentials/asset handoff. Who can take which?
mark_sales: I can own the SKU mapping and pricing inputs. will sync with maria_finance for final numbers.
jen_legal: I can do EULA + export controls review, but need the proposed SKU descriptions and target regions. Please send redlines by EOD if possible.
alan_product: Packaging proposal: three SKUs (starter, team, scale). Suggested trial: 14-day trial or 100k token credit, whichever hits first. Also need clear feature bullets per SKU.
luis_ops: For creds/provisioning I need account contacts + intended cloud accounts. For each cloud:
```
AWS: role ARN with external-id
GCP: service-account email + key rotation plan
Azure: service principal + tenant id
```
If you ping me the emails I can create the principals and share access notes.
sara_partnerships: I'll assemble a single doc with the SKU rows + region matrix and share in this thread. @jen_legal — can you confirm any mandatory clauses for trials (auto-renew, data retention) we need up front?
jen_legal: Confirmed: must include trial auto-expire (no auto-charge), data retention window (30 days after trial), and a simple export restriction blurb for covered countries. I'll draft a one-paragraph template.
mark_sales: Also flagging that gov customers may need separate entitlements — cc @maria_finance for pricing exceptions and seat models.
maria_finance: Noted. For pricing we need estimated monthly token burn for each SKU and suggested overage rates. Send model by tomorrow and I'll review.
sara_partnerships: Action items: (1) alan — finalize SKU bullets and trial limits; (2) mark + maria — pricing model; (3) jen — legal blurb & EULA redline; (4) luis — once we drop cloud account emails you'll provision creds. I'll attach brand assets (SVG + PNG) and marketing copy in the doc.
catalog-bot: checklist created: https://redwood.internal/catalog/playbook/1789012345 — items: SKU-table, trial-policy, legal-redline, asset-pack, creds-request.
mark_sales: tiny ask — can we include a simple migration note for customers moving from hosted to dedicated? one-liner in SKU doc should do it.
alan_product: added migration bullet.
sara_partnerships: Great — I'll consolidate and ping again when the doc is ready for signoff. :thumbsup:
